description:
Make the shared Delete/archive command disable the selected connector and successfully stop its runtime before archival for every adapter. Preserve historical rows and PersonChannel references. Reuse existing confirmation; WhatsApp logout uses the configured package callback, other adapters default to ordinary disable. A failed logout leaves enablement unchanged; a failed shutdown leaves a disabled, unarchived connector for retry. Already disabled/archived retries must not repeat logout or restart runtimes. Keep exact ID/provider/kind/revision validation, actor permissions and watch/ingress teardown ordering.

Action reuse assessment: extend Engine.ConnectorLifecycle.archive/3 and reuse persist_disable, sync_runtime, revision checks and archive persistence; existing ArchiveChannelConnector Action and BO :archive_channel_connector consumers share this implementation. Add an optional provider-neutral before_disable callback routed by CommunicationBridge to JidoChatBridge; Jido reuses logout/2 only when trusted logout_mfa exists and preserves current super-admin authorization. Internal Channels prepare-disable leaf uses NodeRouter Event and supplied config; no new independently composable Action or agent tool. Default bridges need no custom hook. Stop watches/ingress before credentials or runtime are removed; do not hold a DB row lock across external logout. Recheck the disabled revision before archival to reject concurrent edits/re-enable.

Approval: user explicitly approved updating existing archive/runtime-failure test expectations and equivalent scenarios so failed shutdown prevents archival. Preserve unrelated assertions.

Validation: focused lifecycle ordering/failure/retry/property tests, optional hook/default/permission tests, BO delete regression tests across supported adapter pages, mix q and final mix precommit (use ERL_FLAGS='+S 4:4' due previously verified host scheduling contention). New feature browser E2E remains under existing zaq-0l7.7 UX gate and zaq-0l7.8 consolidated journeys.

Policies: AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/channels.md, docs/services/engine.md, docs/services/system-config.md, docs/testing-approach.md, DESIGN.md, docs/bo-components.md. No commit/push requested.

comments.text: Implementation and required local validation complete. Shared Delete disables/stops before archive across adapters; optional Jido hook logs out WhatsApp. Shutdown failure retains disabled/unarchived row; retries skip logout/ingress teardown and require successful stop. User-approved archive expectations updated. Broader precommit passed 10081 tests plus 201 properties/17 doctests. UX and E2E follow-up remains tracked separately in zaq-0l7.7 and zaq-0l7.8.

title: [zaq-iie] Disable adapter connectors before deleting them
